One public container for all zones
Same account keys emailed to every vendor
Separate storage accounts/containers with distinct RBAC boundaries
opciones.explicacion: Isolation boundaries limit lateral movement and oversharing.

pregunta: A media streaming company (~50,000 events/s, region brazilsouth) must: only the pipeline identity—not interactive users—should write to gold. Which option fits best? Constraint set #5.

opciones.texto_opcion: Give all readers Contributor on storage
Use account key in user notebooks for gold writes
Use the factory/workspace MSI for write; grant users read-only
opciones.explicacion: Separating write identities from human readers strengthens control.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable auth on gold

pregunta: Incident review (australiaeast): pipelines must not hardcode ADLS or SQL secrets. Select the most appropriate design. Constraint set #6.

opciones.texto_opcion: Share secrets via SMS
Store secrets in Azure Key Vault and reference via linked services / MSI
opciones.explicacion: Key Vault + managed identity is the standard secret pattern.

opciones.texto_opcion: Hardcode secrets in ADF JSON committed to git
Put passwords in pipeline annotations

pregunta: A logistics carrier (~200 million rows/day, region westeurope) must: ADF should authenticate to ADLS without keys in config. Which option fits best? Constraint set #6.

opciones.texto_opcion: Account key in plain parameters
Anonymous public access
System/user-assigned managed identity with RBAC on storage
Daily emailed SAS with no expiry
